achievements.name: Through Erebus
achievements.detail: Clear Erebus and defeat Hecate at the end of that region.

achievements.name: Sirens Below
achievements.detail: Clear Oceanus and defeat Scylla and the Sirens.

achievements.name: Mourning Fields
achievements.detail: Cross the Fields of Mourning and defeat Cerberus.

achievements.name: Chronos Falls
achievements.detail: Reach the end of Tartarus and defeat Chronos.

achievements.name: City of Ephyra
achievements.detail: Take the surface route and defeat Polyphemus in the City of Ephyra.

achievements.name: The Summit
achievements.detail: Finish the surface climb and defeat Typhon at the Summit.

achievements.name: Nocturnal Arms
achievements.detail: Unlock all six Nocturnal Arms at the Silver Pool.

achievements.name: Arcana Spread
achievements.detail: Unlock Arcana cards and equip some at the Altar of Ashes before a night.

achievements.name: Cauldron Cast
achievements.detail: Cast an incantation at the cauldron in the Crossroads.

achievements.name: Familiar Found
achievements.detail: Befriend an animal familiar and take that companion on a night.

achievements.name: Keepsake Earned
achievements.detail: Give Nectar to an ally until you receive that character's Keepsake.

achievements.name: Quest's End
achievements.detail: See Melinoë's quest through to the credits.
